languageSpecifications.intro_line2: Alexandre Astier has just arrived at the hospital's emergency room. He fell off his horse while wearing armor at the great Cameliard tournament. Now it's up to you!
languageSpecifications.intro_line3: Antoine Wonders has just arrived at the hospital's emergency room. He cut himself while creating a board game. Now it's up to you!
languageSpecifications.intro_line4: Boromir Stark has just arrived at the hospital's emergency room. He was wounded during an acupuncture session with his Orc buddies. Now it's up to you!
languageSpecifications.intro_line5: Elsa Blue has just arrived at the hospital's emergency room. She fell and got stuck in her freezer while she was defrosting it. Now it's up to you!
languageSpecifications.intro_line6: Frank Enstein has just arrived at the hospital's emergency room. He was electrocuted by a mad scientist. Now it's up to you!
languageSpecifications.intro_line7: Lila Runcloud has just arrived at the hospital's emergency room. She burnt her finger with her laser vegetable peeler while cooking. Now it's up to you!
languageSpecifications.intro_line8: Mr Phal has just arrived at the hospital's emergency room. His beard got caught in his bicycle's gears during a race. Now it's up to you!
languageSpecifications.intro_line9: Roberto Traga has just arrived at the hospital's emergency room. He slipped while leaping from the bridge of his ship and broke his leg. Now it's up to you!
languageSpecifications.intro_line10: Rose Well has just arrived at the hospital's emergency room. She crashed her flying saucer in a nearby desert. Now it's up to you!
languageSpecifications.intro_line11: Ryan Private has just arrived at the hospital's emergency room. He suffers from amnesia after a blow to his helmet. You must help him remember who he is. Now it's up to you!
languageSpecifications.intro_line12: Castella Castalo has just arrived at the hospital's emergency room. She sprained her vocal cords at her last concert. Now it's up to you!
languageSpecifications.intro_line13: Willy Free has just arrived at the hospital's emergency room. He has tuna-related food poisoning and his stomach must be operated on immediately. Now it's up to you!
languageSpecifications.event_line1: The air conditioning has failed! Mop the forehead of each of the other players.
languageSpecifications.event_line2: It's your birthday! All of the other players must sing "Happy Birthday" and give you a kiss on the cheek.
languageSpecifications.event_line3: Complete blackout! All of the players close their eyes and shout: "Who's the idiot who cut off the power?"
languageSpecifications.event_line4: The hospital has two new managers! Each player shakes hands with the player on their left and introduces themselves with their first name, last name and job.
languageSpecifications.event_line5: The patient you're operating on is a celebrity! Now take a picture of all the players and post it on social media!
languageSpecifications.event_line6: The C-section is successful! All of the players must kiss the baby (the youngest player).
languageSpecifications.event_line7: There's a surprise equipment inspection! All of the Instrument cards must be sterilized.
languageSpecifications.event_line8: Some players got an electric shock! One player from each team lies on the ground and another player must mime 10 cardiac massages.
languageSpecifications.event_line9: The patient is a famous spy and the operating room is bugged! Players must whisper until the end of the current challenge.
languageSpecifications.event_line10: We won the cup! All of the players jump in place for joy with their arms in the air, shouting: "And one, and two, and three-nil!"
languageSpecifications.event_line11: The players have forgotten to put on gloves! All of the players must mime, with sound effects, the act of putting on a pair of gloves.
languageSpecifications.event_line12: There's a helium leak! All of the players must talk in very high-pitched voices until the end of the current challenge.
languageSpecifications.event_line13: The patient is hemorrhaging! One player from each team must keep a finger on the heart until the end of the current challenge.
languageSpecifications.event_line14: There's an inspection of the team. Each player must build a house of cards with 2 Instrument cards.
languageSpecifications.event_line15: Your team is international! Each player chooses an accent and must keep it until the end of the current challenge.
languageSpecifications.event_line16: All of the players are training for a marathon! They must run once around the table, shouting: "One, two, one, two…"
languageSpecifications.event_line17: New equipment has just been delivered. All of the players must go to the door of the room and pretend to sign the delivery note.
languageSpecifications.event_line18: A fly has invaded the operating room! Throw a card in the air, shouting: "Watch out for the fly!" Another player must catch the card and put it back. Otherwise, start again!
languageSpecifications.event_line19: Your team is congratulated for its flawless work! All of the players shake hands while saying: "Congratulations, you're doing an excellent job!"
languageSpecifications.event_line20: There's a suspicious smell in the operating room! All of the players continue the current challenge while pinching their noses.
languageSpecifications.event_line21: An oxygen leak has been detected in the operating room! All of the players lie on the ground with their hands on their heads, then count to 10 together.
languageSpecifications.event_line22: There's a power outage! To get the power back on, all of the players must lie on their backs and pedal while counting aloud to 10.
languageSpecifications.event_line23: The radiation alarm has just gone off! All of the players rush to the nearest toilet, lock themselves in and count aloud to 10.
languageSpecifications.event_line24: The new intern knocked over the cart holding all of the instruments! Throw 5 Instrument cards on the floor. The players must put them back in place.
languageSpecifications.event_line25: There's an earthquake! All of the players hop in place until the end of the current challenge.
languageSpecifications.credit_line2: The "Doctor Panic" boardgame is required to play.
